name: Git Plugin UI
description: UI sub-spec for the Git version control panel: split-pane layout, branch/remote selects, staged/unstaged file lists, commit input, commits history, file tree diff, and unified/side-by-side diff viewer.

interactions.behavior: Calls gitCheckout to switch branch, then refreshes all data
Toggles collapsible section; rotates arrow icon (▸ → ▾)
Calls git:stagedDiff or git:unstagedDiff and displays diff in right panel
Fetches commit details (git:showTree) and shows file tree in top-right panel

interactions.trigger: click on file in commit tree
interactions.behavior: Fetches file diff for that commit via git:diff and displays in bottom-right panel
Stages all unstaged changes, creates commit via git:commit with input message

interactions.trigger: mouse drag on vertical resize handle
interactions.behavior: Resizes top/bottom panel split in right column

interactions.trigger: click on diff view mode dropdown

interactions.behavior: If message not empty and staged files exist, triggers commit

states.name: loading
states.description: First load: fetching branches, remotes, commits, and changes

states.name: commit-selected
states.description: A commit is selected; top-right shows file tree, bottom-right shows diff or placeholder

states.name: change-selected
states.description: A staged/unstaged file is selected; bottom-right shows its diff

states.name: no-commits
states.description: Empty repository or no commits yet

states.name: no-selection
states.description: Right panel shows 'Select a commit or file to view diff' placeholder

states.name: changes-expanded
states.description: Staged or unstaged section is expanded showing file list

states.name: changes-collapsed
states.description: Staged or unstaged section collapsed (arrow pointing right)
